reason: CR 730.3c: WaitingFor::TopOrBottomChoice gains optional components (Vec<ObjectId>, omitted when empty) recording the physical components of a merged permanent at prompt time so a prompt answered after the pile split (Arashin Sovereign's dies trigger on a merged permanent) moves and arranges every component.
